ValidationRule.description: WM Involvement is required for App Cases when Status equals "Closed". W-002565 - added On Hold Date line to allow auto close for On Hold Cases. 2/2/26 - Added Bypass validation permission and not Support Coordination bc Clone PLI flow was hitting rule.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(WMInvolvement__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(Status,'Solution Delivered')), ISBLANK(On_Hold_Date__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'App_Cases', NOT(ISPICKVAL( Reason, 'Support Coordination')) )
&& NOT( $Permission.BypassValidationRules )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: WM Involvement is required for App Cases when Status equals "Closed".
